alphabet_policy: injective sorted-symbol relabeling to shared inventory; report actual cardinality, never merge distinct symbols
normalization: lowercase; NFKD accents removed; long-s to s; ae/oe ligatures expanded; sharp-s to ss; join line-break hyphens; alphabetic words only, no OCR spelling corrections
entropy: h0=H(X); h1=H(X_t|X_t-1); h2=H(X_t|X_t-2,X_t-1), empirical plug-in bits/token within locus only
noise: symmetric minimal-edit rates reconstructed from Phase 0 eligible LSI pairs; IID single-pass per existing character including spaces; uniform substituted/inserted symbol; no newline edits; same fixed rates every control
